title: What verify decided
description:
The machine-readable half of a verify run: the plan, the observation it was judged against, and every check with its outcome. Section 10 of the brief asks for a report in the same two forms as the plan, and this is the one Semaphore keeps.

The plan is the promise and the observation is the reading. This document is neither: it is the comparison, and it carries enough of both that somebody reading it a year later does not need either file to understand what was decided.

schema_version.description: The version of this contract. A consumer refuses a document whose version it does not implement rather than guessing at a field that moved.

version.description: The engine version the plan requested.

observed_at.description: When the instance was read. Not the same moment as the judgement, and the gap between them is worth being able to see.

summary.description: How many checks came to each outcome. Three, because a check that could not be run is not a check that passed.

verified.description: Whether the instance is the one the plan describes. False when anything failed and false when anything could not be observed, because a run that proved nothing about a check has not verified it.

kind.description: The kind the profile named, carried so a reader can tell which question was put.

outcome.description: Three, and the third is the one worth spelling out. `unobserved` is a check the run could not put to the instance at all -- the instance was down, or the reading the check needs is not in the observation document. It is not a pass, it refuses the run, and it is kept apart from `fail` because what somebody does about it is different: a failure says the instance is wrong, and an unobserved check says nobody managed to ask (ADR-0025).

observed.description: What was read back, in the terms the person reading the report thinks in. On a failure this is the whole of what makes the report useful.

expected.description: What the plan promised, where a check has a single thing to compare against.

remediation.description: What to do about it, from the profile. Present on anything that is not a pass.

expression.description: The profile's expression, where the check carried one. Recorded because a check that failed on its expression rather than on its kind is a different finding, and the report should not make somebody open the profile to tell which.
